info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Employee Data Management API
info.description: The Employee Data Management API facilitates the efficient handling of employee information within the organization. This API enables businesses to onboard new employees, update existing records, and manage various aspects of human resource data seamlessly. It serves HR professionals and system integrators looking to maintain accurate and up-to-date employee profiles, ensuring compliance with legal and organizational requirements. Typical use cases include adding new employee details, modifying roles and responsibilities, and ensuring data consistency across HR systems.

post.description: This endpoint allows the creation of new employee data in the human resource management system. Ensure all required fields are populated to successfully add a new employee record.

requestBody.description: The request body contains the necessary information to create or update employee data within the human resource management system. Ensure that all fields are filled according to the specified schema.
